retrieval_rule: Retrieve by system + engineering topic + flow type + application/subsystem. Jurisdiction/source location is metadata and a scoring/context field, not a primary filter.
exclusion_rule: A WATER_SUPPLY query must exclude SEWERAGE and DRAINAGE records unless the user explicitly requests comparison across systems.
calculation_rule: Numerical design results come from deterministic calculation tools; RAG provides criteria, methods, applicability and references.
